name: Leche Flan
instructions:
1. Using all the eggs, separate the yolks from the egg whites (only the egg yolks will be used).

2. Place the egg yolks in a large bowl, then beat them using a fork or egg beater.

3. Add the condensed milk and mix thoroughly.

4. Pour in the fresh milk and vanilla. Mix well.

5. Place the mold (llanera) on top of the stove and heat over low fire.

6. Put the granulated sugar in the mold and mix continuously until the solid sugar melts into caramel with a light brown color.
   *Note: If llanera is unavailable, individual round pans can be used as an alternative.*

7. Spread the caramel (liquid sugar) evenly on the flat surface of the mold.

8. Wait for 5 minutes to let the caramel set, then pour the egg yolk and milk mixture into the mold.

9. Cover the top of the mold with aluminum foil.

10. Steam the mold containing the egg and milk mixture for 30 to 35 minutes.

11. After steaming, let it cool to room temperature, then refrigerate.

12. Serve for dessert. Share and enjoy!
